clay.name: Claymation diorama
clay.lead: A handmade stop-motion claymation diorama of a tiny world, sculpted entirely from soft matte plasticine with visible thumbprints and gently rounded edges, sitting on a thick round wooden base. In the diorama:
clay.look: Chunky, slightly squashed proportions and little clay figures with simple bead eyes.
clay.guard: The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Nothing extends beyond its edges: no horizon, sky or distant scenery behind it. Show only what is described: no extra people or animals. Plain seamless warm off-white background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.

lowpoly.name: Low-poly floating island

lowpoly.look: Clean stylized game-asset look: every element, including people, furniture, food and plants, is built from flat-shaded faceted polygons in soft pastel colors, with no realistic textures.
lowpoly.guard: The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.

miniature.look: Tilt-shift toy-world feel with true-to-life textures at tiny scale, the whole miniature in sharp focus.
